title: Implement operator CLI: status, pin, unpin, gc-run, peer-list
description:
Implement a subcommand CLI for operator use (via the same binary with subcommands or a separate ops binary): transit status (print peer count, article count, pinned count), transit pin <cid>, transit unpin <cid>, transit gc-run (trigger immediate GC), transit peer-list (print connected peers). CLI communicates with running daemon via admin socket or HTTP. Artifact: transit/src/cli/ or transit/src/admin.rs.

Acceptance:
- All five subcommands work against a running daemon
- transit gc-run triggers GC and waits for completion before printing summary
- Unknown subcommands print usage and exit 1
- JSON output flag available for all commands
